about_the_game:
In the demo version of Your Big, Cute Monster Farm, you’ll experience:

  • Desktop idle gameplay – let cute monsters accompany you while you work or study!

  • Recruit and merge monsters – build a powerful farming squad!

  • Gather resources and decorate your land – create a unique farm of your own!

The full version will feature even more adorable monsters and brand-new gameplay. Stay tuned!
